note: Per-domain tolerance ceilings for golden vectors (add-trust-and-proof design T5). A field looser than its domain's ceiling needs a justification below, matched by the start of the vector's source; checked by tools/trust/tolerance.test.mjs. Indexing's 'exact' is read as: integers exact, computed coordinates, lengths, and areas to double-precision rounding (1e-8 relative).

justified.source: FAA Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge
justified.reason: The handbook reads density altitude off its chart, which resolves no finer than about 100 ft.

MetPy takes saturation vapor pressure from Bolton (1980) and the tool from Alduchov and Eskridge (1996); the two fits differ by up to 0.31% from -40 to 45 °C, so the vapor figures are held to 0.4%, the dew point to 0.05 °C, and the virtual temperature to 0.02 °C. The densities are held to 5 parts in 100,000.
